complete_examples.text: Generally, these empirical models are used to establish the functional relationship between the number of loading cycles and permanent deformation (or strain) through tests.
In this paper, a model combining (i) the train-track-subgrade interaction and (ii) the prediction model of permanent deformation of the subgrade is integrated and established.
